title: Bioflux Analyses: Modelling
author: Tobias Weise
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb7sirne

steps.title: Import Python packages
steps.instruction: Import numpy as np, pandas as pd, scipy.integrate, and fmin from scipy.optimize.

steps.title: Define ODE and kinetic equations
steps.instruction: Write the ordinary differential equation dI_pix/dt = µ_max·λ(t)·χ(I_pix)·I_pix, where χ(I_pix)=1‑I_pix/I_pix,max (logistic term) and λ(t)=1‑exp[-(t+td)/(ti+td)] (Wolf lag term). Set the adherence time td = 1.5 h for all simulations.

steps.title: Implement growth‑kinetics functions
steps.instruction: Create Python functions: chi(Ipixmax, Ipix) returning 1‑Ipix/Ipixmax; wolf(ti, td, t) returning 1‑exp(-(t+td)/(ti+td)); mu(mumax, Ipixmax, ti, td, Ipix, t) returning mumax * chi * wolf.

steps.title: Create ODE integration function
steps.instruction: Define function eq(indep_par, exp_par, start_t, end_t, incr) that extracts initial condition Ipix0, assigns mumax, Ipixmax, ti from indep_par, sets td = exp_par, builds time vector t = np.linspace(start_t, end_t, incr), defines inner function funct(y,t) computing dIpixdt = mu(...)*Ipix and dtindt = 1, integrates with scipy.integrate.odeint, and returns (Ipix_series, t).

steps.title: Configure parameter estimation
steps.instruction: Plan to simulate each experiment for 24 h using the lsoda integrator (scipy.integrate.odeint). Vectorise parameters θ = (µ_max, Ipix_max, ti, Ipix0). Define cost function J(θ)= Σ (Ipix_data – Ipix_model)^2. Choose the downhill‑simplex (Nelder‑Mead) method via scipy.optimize.fmin with standard convergence criteria.

steps.title: Define scoring function
steps.instruction: Write Python function score(parms) that (a) solves the ODE with eq(parms, exp_rates, 0, time, 100), (b) creates model time grid mt = np.linspace(0, time, 100), (c) finds indices matching experimental timestamps, (d) extracts model Ipix at those indices, and (e) returns the sum of squared differences between data.Ipix and data.Ipix_model.

steps.title: Execute parameter estimation
steps.instruction: Set initials = [Ipix_zero, mumax, ti, Ipix_max]; set exp_rates = 1.5 h; set time = 24 h; call scipy.optimize.fmin(score, rates, full_output=1, retall=1, maxiter=1000). Store optimal parameters as estimates = answ[0] and final score as score_value = answ[1].

steps.title: Determine max growth metrics
steps.instruction: From the fitted Ipix and growth‑rate time series, record the peak growth‑rate value and the corresponding time point for each strain (height and time of maximum observable growth).

steps.title: Plot comparative growth results
steps.instruction: Create a scatter plot of maximum growth rates versus their time points for wild‑type and mutant strains (Fig. 3.1‑A). Then generate a differential plot showing the difference between mutant and wild‑type values (Fig. 3.1‑B).
